source_suite.scope: Three new actual API35 reference methods only: ordinary same-UID separate-process FileProvider metadata/nonpersistable access, sandbox file URI metadata/bookmarks/real missing reads and one cross-UID ordinary document read/persistable Activity result followed by owner revoke. No replay of accepted lifecycle5/oversize/host or pending default-Coil methods. Post-revoke ordinary-document release is idempotent revoked release, not live-release proof; FileProvider opens count successfully returned PFDs, not provider entries. No system/cloud/ExternalStorage/Downloads/DocumentsUI, reboot/whole-app restart, default decoder, memory/key, Apple scopes, packaged consumer/API-ABI or security/release certification.

Three new API35 library/source-app tests only: approved fresh Call grant, actual denial/permanent-denial, real document/photo picker and bounded synthetic reads. No sample UI, phone call, recording, Android13/14 selected-media or packaged/minimum/ABI/security/release inference.

One exact finite storage API/flavor/target method, not unrestricted Android/default-suite coverage. Separate-UID public WriteStorage, real normal-UID descriptor bytes, actual system SAF and native WRITE/all-files restoration remain required. No manual URI grant, source/sample substitution, physical/vendor/settings-dialog/process-restoration/consumer/API-ABI/security/release certification.
